context_quotes: Structural and mechanical characteristics were evaluated using the GGA-PBE functional, while the electronic and transport properties were calculated with the hybrid HSE06 functional.

records.subject: Transformation of monoclinic Cu2SnS3 to cubic phase
records.quote: Here, based on optimizing electrical transport by transforming monoclinic Cu2SnS3 into a cubic phase, Halogen atoms are employed alloying to enhance anharmonicity, effectively suppressing phonon propagation in high-symmetry materials, thereby reducing kappa lat while maintaining excellent electrical transport properties.

records.subject: Polymeric ionic liquid gate dielectric in an electrochemical transistor
